chunks: As for what Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from Zakariyyā ibn ʿImrān, he said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about the mutamattiʿ when the Day of ʿArafah has begun. He said: There is no tamattuʿ for him; he makes it into a separate ʿumrah.

key_terms.عُمْرَةً مُفْرَدَةً: a standalone ʿumrah not joined to hajj as tamattuʿ
key_terms.لَا مُتْعَةَ لَهُ: tamattuʿ no longer applies to him in this situation
key_terms.يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ: the Day of ʿArafah, a key time marker in the rites of hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a mutamattiʿ who reaches the Day of ʿArafah before completing tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the one performing tamattuʿ who reaches the Day of ʿArafah without completing the required stage in time. The Imam عليه السلام rules that tamattuʿ no longer applies in this case, and the act is to be treated as a separate ʿumrah. Its significance lies in defining the time limit for joining Hajj al-tamattuʿ.
